title: JSON Fence Validation Blackbox Harness and Canary for Constrained Decoding
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Background: We continue to see flaky failures when JSON-mode outputs interleave with tool/function-calls and streaming chunks. This ticket creates a deterministic blackbox harness and a small canary pipeline that validates enforced JSON fences and constrained-decoding behavior across model variants and streaming transport layers. Scope: end-to-end harness that exercises: 1) enforced JSON fence tokens and sentinel recovery, 2) constrained-decoder backoff paths when model emits invalid tokens mid-stream, 3) tool-calling interleaving (tool markers inside JSON fields), and 4) compatibility with streaming reassembly and the console ingest path. Out of scope: large-scale long-tail fuzzing (will be a follow-up) and SDK surface changes. Goal: reduce production JSON-mode misparse incidents by 80% for affected routes and provide an automated canary that gates runtime-1.21 rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run deterministically in CI and reproduce 10 canonical failure scenarios (listed in test_plan)
Canary pipeline runs daily and emits a pass/fail metric to the structured-output health dashboard
When the model emits invalid intermediate tokens, the constrained-decoder fallback path is exercised and produces documented, recoverable outputs (logs + metrics) for all supported model families
Tool-call markers embedded in JSON strings do not break schema parsing in >=95% of regression runs across 3 model seeds
All failures include: canonical payload, model seed, partial stream transcript, decoder state snapshot ID, and a link to the failed replay in the harness UI
test_plan: Create 10 canonical scenarios: prefix truncation, mid-field rogue punctuation, interleaved toolcall start/end, partial KV cache loss, bursty chunk boundaries, intentional token corruption, mixed-encoding (UTF-8/latin1) payloads, long-JSON arrays with streaming partials, nested schema edge-case, and backpressure-triggered chunk splits

Implement a harness runner that can: 1) run models with fixed temperature/seed, 2) toggle constrained-decoder rules (strict/relaxed), 3) simulate streaming transport at configurable chunk sizes and reordering, and 4) capture decoder checkpoints for replay
Add golden-schema assertions with both strict JSON-parser and lenient-recovery mode; record divergence count per run
Integrate harness with console telemetry: emit metrics for constraint-violations, recovery-paths, average token-rewrites, and false-positive rate versus golden schema
Create a daily canary job in CI that runs the harness against runtime-1.21 and the two most common open models; failing canary blocks promoted runtime builds
Add replayable artifacts to GCS with index file for quick repro and attach to the Linear ticket automatically on failure
notes: Design trade-offs considered: strict enforcement reduces downstream parsing complexity but increases failure surface for hallucinations; we will run both strict and relaxed modes side-by-side for 2 weeks to measure real-world false-positive vs. false-negative trade-offs. We decided to prioritize deterministic harnesses over ad-hoc fuzz because reproducibility is critical for debugging streaming recovery. We will not attempt model fine-tuning in this ticket — only runtime and decoder behaviors.
